fields.name: OrleansShardPersistenceOptions
fields.description: Mutable state used to select a sharded Orleans persistence provider, identify its shard set, choose whether grain keys are checked, supply query definitions, and carry a storage serializer and lifecycle initialization stage required by the Orleans options interface.

members.name: ShardSetKey
members.description: The key used both for the shard set and for the Orleans storage provider; defaults to the default Orleans storage provider name.

members.name: ValidateGrainKeys
members.description: Whether grain identity and model key matching is enforced on write and clear, per the field's declared purpose; defaults to true. ArgentSeaShardGrainPersistence<TShardOptions> captures the value when it is constructed and passes it to the write and clear delegate builders; the compiled delegates are cached in static fields keyed by the Orleans state name, the state type and the ValidateGrainKeys value. So providers configured with different values never share a cached delegate, and neither do state types that share a state name. What the delegate builder does with the captured value is outside this component's evidence.

members.name: Queries
members.description: A mutable lookup of the available persistence query definitions by GrainType; defaults to empty.

members.name: InitStage
members.description: The silo lifecycle stage value stored for storage initialization scheduling; defaults to ApplicationServices. Currently unconsumed: the lifecycle-participation code that would subscribe to this stage is commented out in ArgentSeaShardGrainPersistence.

members.name: GrainStorageSerializer
members.description: The Orleans-required storage serializer, explicitly implemented via IStorageProviderSerializerOptions and defaulted to a FakeGrainStorageSerializer, a no-op serializer. Not used by ArgentSeaShardGrainPersistence, which maps grain state through query parameters and result sets rather than a serialized blob.

representations.CSharp: public class OrleansShardPersistenceOptions with string, bool, Dictionary<string, OrleansShardQueryDefinitions>, int, and an explicitly-implemented IGrainStorageSerializer member.
